title: Primitive Baptist Church, 1930s in Upper Brighton
description: The Upper Brighton Primitive Baptist Church was founded in 1874 by Rev. G. W. Orser, who previously led a 2,000-member group known as the ‘Orserites’, later called the Primitive Baptists. Hartland is one of the few communities recognized as the birthplace of this Christian denomination. The Tabernacle, located on the west side of the St. John River, hosted annual gatherings where a monument stands in honor of Rev. G. W. Orser, founder of the Primitive Baptist denomination. This picture was taken during their quarterly meeting fellowship with Holmesville, Fredericton, Bristol and Upper Brighton, which they still do today.
